# `foxglove site-notification-tokens add`

[Command reference](README.md) · [Parent command](site-notification-tokens.md)

```text
Create a bucket notification token for a Primary Site and print it once

Usage: foxglove site-notification-tokens add [OPTIONS] --site-id <SITE_ID>

Options:
      --client-id <CLIENT_ID>
          Foxglove client ID

      --format <FORMAT>
          Render output in table, JSON, or CSV format

          [default: table]
          [possible values: table, json, csv]

      --config <CONFIG>
          Config file

      --site-id <SITE_ID>
          Primary Site ID (required)

      --debug[=<DEBUG>]
          Print debug diagnostics, including HTTP requests, to stderr

          [default: false]

  -h, --help
          Print help
```
